invariants.rationale: The method always returns an instance from execute(), which is unlikely to be null.
HoodieWriteMetadata should provide non-null write status results reflecting operation outcome.
A List's size is always non-negative.
The number of write statuses for delete operations cannot exceed the number of requested delete keys, if keys are provided.
HoodieWriteMetadata typically provides partition write stats; should not be null after operation.
